acceptance: The AI Settings timeout field accepts and persists 65535 seconds; focused tests prove the new cap; settings validation still repairs invalid non-positive values without clamping valid positive timeouts; documentation explains that current provider calls are blocking and that streaming or idle-timeout support would be a separate enhancement.
alignment.reason: The user supplied the cap and scope is limited to settings UI, focused tests, and documentation; no policy-sensitive or medium-risk open question remains.
scope: In scope: raise the AI Settings timeout control cap to 65535 seconds, add focused tests for the cap/persistence behavior, and update relevant component documentation about timeout behavior and the current non-streaming progress limitation. Out of scope for this slice: implementing streaming chat completions, partial JSON persistence, provider-specific job polling, or UI progress semantics for streamed token activity.
alignment.understanding: Increase the AI Settings request-timeout cap from the current UI limit of 3600 seconds to 65535 seconds so local large-context model runs can be left running overnight, while preserving existing settings validation and current non-streaming OpenAI-compatible request behavior. The implementation should also document the current limitation: AudioMancer waits on a blocking chat-completions response, so it cannot reliably interrogate per-request progress unless a future streaming or backend-specific progress design is added.
